question: How are action, knowledge, will, shambhu, and the fifth established?
premises: Action, knowledge, and will are named.
Shambhu and the fifth are included.
The threefold division of the great lord is the setting.
inference: These five are established in the threefold division, including waking and so on.
uncertainties: Exact referent of the fifth is implicit.
plain_english: Own action, knowledge, will, Shambhu, and the fifth are established in the threefold division of the great lord, including waking and the rest.
